Services

What the workshop does

From the workshop’s own posts and from what customers write in their Google reviews.

Oil change

The workshop advertises oil changes on its own advertising banner, together with both phone numbers.

Air conditioning

One customer came to have the air conditioning fixed and was very happy with the service. Photos of the workshop show A/C service units.

Tyres

One customer writes that the tyres were changed within an hour, with all measurements done.

When the car won’t start

One customer called in the morning because her car would not start, brought it in right away and picked it up the same afternoon.

How customers describe a visit

Taken from what customers write in their Google reviews.

Quick to see you

Customers write about a call on Friday afternoon and an appointment on Saturday morning, or a call in the morning and the car ready in the afternoon.

Kind and clear

Customers describe the workshop as kind, informative and genuinely helpful, also for people who know little about cars.

Fair prices

Google reviews mention reasonable and very good prices, and advice that fits the budget.

On Athalassas Avenue

The workshop is at Athalassas Avenue 45 in Strovolos, Nicosia. A photo from the Google listing shows a car being serviced under a white canopy. The logo carries a chequered flag next to the name Mettis, and the owner replies to reviews on Google.
